title: Ground airline booking guidance in tool-backed state
summary:
Replaced conflicting airline-support instructions with tool-backed guidance to keep booking responses grounded and truthful.

- Clarified booking authority, read-only verification, booking attribution, and seat-change guidance.
- Confirmed the active streaming path uses the replacement instructions and added focused construction and wiring tests.

Tests and real-model replay were not run, so semantic improvement remains unvalidated.
